question: What nature does the one supreme in power come to enjoy?
premises: The agent is characterized as supreme in power.
This agent enjoys their own inherent nature.
inference: Supreme power culminates in the enjoyment of an own-nature that dispels inauspiciousness.
uncertainties: The precise nuance of parākrama+paraḥ (supreme in valor versus devoted to supreme power) is context-dependent.
plain_english: The one supreme in power enjoys their own nature, which removes all inauspiciousness.
